text:
elaine: quick sync - strict fncall validation in canary flagged a bunch of search_tool calls where clients send `result: null` instead of `result.items: []`. hitting eu-west slice.
ravi: reject-rate ~3.0% on the canary. most apps expect null semantics. we need a low-friction mitigation.
carmen: options: (1) flip validator to permissive for that tool, (2) route rejects to a coercion adapter that rewrites null->[] and tag the event. (2) preserves canary coverage but complicates billing tags.
elaine: console owners will want an immediate toggle per-tool to enable coercion/soft-accept. product teams should be able to opt-in.
ravi: telemetry suggestion: emit metric `fncall.schema.rejects` with tags tool=search_tool, reason=missing_items, action=coerce|reject and sample N payloads to our S3 bucket for triage.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: strict-fncall-validator canary=10% started 2026-03-20T09:17:00Z
carmen: billing: if we coerce we still bill tokens. propose adding `billing_path=coercion` tag when adapter runs so finance can separate out these flows.
elaine: agree. also add `route_annotation=coercion_adapter` so rollups show up in the console route breakdown.
abby: small UX ask: Console should show a historical graph: rejects by tool + percent coerced, and a toggle to perform per-tool rollbacks. I'll mock a wireframe.
ravi: immediate action: enable coercion adapter for search_tool in eu-west canary + start sampling 200 events. make validator emit `validator_action=soft_accept` for these.
carmen: I'll push the adapter and sampling. will also add a queryable `validator_action` tag for later exploration.
elaine: freeze other strict validator rollouts until we finish a coupling checks and send owners a deprecation note.
abby: creating a console alert and temporary toggle. ticket: /console/alerts/1735559999
infra-bot: action logged: coercion adapter enable requested (operator: carmen)
elaine: thanks. follow up: product to confirm if null->[] coercion is acceptable, otherwise we'll schedule a breaking change with client outreach. closing thread unless blockers.
